profilerOnOffDeltaInterpretation: These are paired context-level descriptive deltas from one finite episode. They are not causal savings or qualification data.

profileInterpretation.denominator: All raw CDP profile sample ids in that context.
profileInterpretation.updateNumerator: Samples whose call stack contains a frame inside the exact authored update method URL + generated line/column span from the hash-verified served asset.
profileInterpretation.inclusiveAncestors: Counts overlap and must not be summed.
profileInterpretation.timeDeltas: Kept only as profile sampling diagnostics. Never summed or converted into phase CPU milliseconds.
profileInterpretation.calls: The harness executes 72 calls (12 warmup + 60 measured), but the CPU sampler cannot establish per-call coverage. No 60-sample window claim is made.
profileInterpretation.unsampledAndUnmapped: Idle, GC, other runtime, outside-update JavaScript and missing leaf cases remain visible; profiler sampling is not a complete causal ledger.
